events.name: Fireside Chat with Tanay Kothari, Wispr Flow
events.description:
South Park Commons is excited to host Tanay Kothari, co-founder & CEO of Wispr (and SPC alum) for a fireside chat.
Event Details
3:00pm: Doors Open
3:30-4:30pm: Fireside Chat
Tanay Kothari is the co-founder and CEO of Wispr and Wispr Advanced Interfaces Lab. A four-time founder, he launched FeatherX, an AI personalization startup for online stores, while still in college. After it was acquired by Cerebra Technologies, he joined the company to lead engineering and product. Earlier, he built Convert, a music discovery platform that grew to more than 2.5 million organic monthly active users.

Tanay holds a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and a master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence from Stanford, where he taught the university’s Deep Learning course alongside Prof. Andrew Ng and published research at the Stanford AI Lab. He also served as President of the Stanford Venture Capital Club for three years. In 2023, he was named to the Forbes 30 Under 30 list.

events.name: SPC Energy Forum: Fireside with Garth Sheldon-Coulson, Co-Founder and CEO of Panthalassa
events.description:
The South Park Commons Energy Forum is delighted to host a fireside with Garth Sheldon-Coulson.
Garth Sheldon-Coulson is Co-Founder and CEO of Panthalassa, a company unlocking planetary-scale renewable energy in the middle of the ocean. Panthalassa's technologies capture wave energy far from shore and use it to produce AI compute delivered by satellite and renewable fuels delivered by ship. Panthalassa's 200-person team is headquartered in Portland, Oregon and backed by leading venture capital firms.

events.name: Fireside Chat with Abhinav Gupta, Skild.ai
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Abhinav Gupta, co-founder of Skild.ai.
Event Details
4:30pm: Doors Open
5:00-6:00pm: Fireside Chat

Abhinav Gupta serves as President and Co‑Founder of Skild AI. He is also a Professor at the Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University. Prior to this, Abhinav was founding research lead at FAIR Robotics and worked at Google and AI2 as well.
At Skild, Abhinav focuses on building a general-purpose brain for robots with a long-term goal of building general purpose intelligence. Abhinav is known for pioneering contributions to AI, including scaling visual and robot learning, self-supervised learning, and lifelong learning systems.
He is a recipient of several awards including IAPR 2020 JK Aggarwal Prize, PAMI 2016 Young Researcher Award, ONR Young Investigator Award, Sloan Research Fellowship, Okawa Foundation Grant, Bosch Young Faculty Fellowship, YPO Fellowship, IJCAI Early Career Spotlight, ICRA Best Student Paper award, and the ECCV Best Paper Runner-up Award. His research has also been featured in Newsweek, BBC, Wall Street Journal, Wired and Slashdot.

events.name: Building the New Energy Frontier at SPC NYC
events.description:
Power is becoming the scarce input for everything: AI, manufacturing, housing, transport. The grid was never built for that demand curve, and the gap between what’s needed and what can be delivered is turning into a market of its own.
Join us at SPC NYC for a conversation on what's next on the energy frontier. Panelists include:
Keeley Erhardt, Strobe Power. Keeley Erhardt is co-founder and CEO of Strobe Power, which turns on-site generation and storage at commercial buildings into dispatchable power plants. Strobe connects these assets to wholesale electricity markets, helping meet growing power demand while lowering energy costs for building owners. Keeley holds three degrees in computer science from MIT, including a PhD.

Britt Reichborn-Kjennerud is Director of Con Edison’s Distribution Planning department where she leads distributed energy resource (DER) integration with the grid including customer demand management programs, distributed generation interconnection support, and DER strategy. Previously in her work at Con Edison she led the development and implementation of the company’s e-mobility programs as Director of E-Mobility, and non- wires program strategy for deploying energy storage and other DERs to meet grid needs.
She also worked in the Research & Development department where she designed and managed projects to introduce new technologies into the company infrastructure and operations. Prior to joining Con Edison in 2014 Britt completed her PhD and a research fellowship in astrophysics at Columbia University.
Moderated by Dan Hunter, Nyquis
Agenda: 
Doors Open—5pm
Panel Discussion—5:30pm-6:30pm
